name: Firecrawl
one_liner: Web search, scrape, interact and crawl API that returns LLM-ready markdown or structured data for AI agents.
auth_notes: Bearer API key in Authorization header. /v2/scrape, /v2/search and /v2/parse work keylessly with limits. OAuth for apps lets users connect their own Firecrawl account.
access_notes: Free plan: 1,000 credits/month, no card required, self-serve key. Paid: Hobby $19/mo monthly or $16/mo annual; Standard $99/$83; Growth $399/$333; Scale $749/$599. No wait or approval stated.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve free key, documented REST API with bearer auth, official SDKs and MCP server. Free tier rate limits are low but not a gate. Scrape, search, map, crawl, interact and agent are all documented.

identity.quote: The API to search, scrape, and interact with the web at scale.

auth.quote: Requests need anAuthorization header with your API key, except on the keyless endpoints described below:
To let users connect their own Firecrawl account to your app instead, use OAuth for apps.

access.quote: Firecrawl gives you 1,000 free credits every month, which covers about 1,000 pages, and no card is required.

api_surface.quote: Search the web and get full page content in any format.

mcp.quote: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that brings Firecrawl, the context API for AI agents, to MCP-compatible clients

buildability.quote: When you exceed your plan’s rate or concurrency limits, the API returns a429 status code.
